title: pi-computer-use: a Pi CLI integration that lets your agent control your applications
description:
Anthropic's Computer Use API lets AI see the screen, move the mouse, and click. pi-computer-use brings that natively to the Pi CLI on macOS.Tell your agent "build a login screen and test if the hover state works" and it writes the React code, spins up your dev server, takes control of your mouse, physically opens Chrome, clicks the button, and visually verifies the result.

https://github.com/injaneity/pi-computer-use
